summary: Warns ZFS on Solaris uses NFSv4 ACLs that Ansible can't use, so world_readable_temp may be needed. Since 2.1 Ansible errors if it can't become securely, and world_readable_temp downgrades this to a warning; 2.10 added the common remote group fallback.
questions: Why does become fail on Solaris ZFS?
Why does Ansible error that it can't become securely?
How do I allow insecure become with unprivileged users?

answer_card.title: Secure-by-default become and ZFS
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Solaris ZFS** uses NFSv4 ACLs, not POSIX.1e, so Ansible can't use them; you may need `world_readable_temp`.
- Since **2.1**, Ansible errors if it can't run `become` securely. If you can't use pipelining or POSIX ACLs and must go unprivileged to unprivileged, and you accept world-readable modules, enable `world_readable_temp` to turn the error into a warning.
- **2.10** added the `ansible_common_remote_group` fallback.
